description.short_caption: Microscopic view of fungal elements with hyphae and budding yeast forms.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a microscopic view of fungal elements, including branching hyphae and numerous budding yeast forms. The organisms are stained to enhance visibility, with the hyphae appearing as elongated structures and the yeast forms as round or oval buds. The image is taken under high magnification, likely using a light microscope.

description.short_caption: Diffuse maculopapular rash on the back.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the back of an individual with a diffuse maculopapular rash. The rash consists of small, erythematous macules and papules distributed across the skin. The image is well-lit, and the rash appears to be non-vesicular and non-confluent. The patient is wearing a patterned top, and no other abnormalities are visible in the surrounding skin.

description.short_caption: Linear erythematous lesions on the forearm, two months after treatment.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the forearm of a patient with linear erythematous lesions extending proximally from the wrist. The lesions appear to follow a lymphatic distribution, with some areas of mild scabbing or crusting, particularly near the wrist. The surrounding skin is otherwise unremarkable, and there is no visible swelling or significant discoloration beyond the lesions.
visible_findings: scabbing or crusting near the wrist

description.short_caption: Bacterial colonies on a culture plate from a wound specimen.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a round culture plate with bacterial colonies growing on an agar medium. The colonies appear as small, raised, and pigmented formations, with some showing a brownish coloration. The plate is labeled with 'PVD,' and there are black redactions obscuring parts of the image. The background is a textured surface, likely a laboratory bench. The colonies suggest microbial growth from a wound specimen.
visible_findings: black redactions obscuring parts of the image

description.short_caption: Ulcerated lesion with erythematous border and central necrotic tissue.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows an ulcerated lesion on the skin of an extremity. The lesion has a central area of necrotic tissue with a yellowish appearance, surrounded by erythema and mild swelling. The edges of the lesion are irregular, and there is no visible purulent drainage. The surrounding skin appears inflamed.
